title: Robbie Norman
text: I am an Industrial Engineering student at the University of Arkansas with experience in facility design, ammonia refrigeration, and wastewater treatment. Through internships with Jurni Design Team and Simmons Prepared Foods, I have used Autodesk software to model processing facilities and analyzed refrigeration operations to identify an estimated $20,000 in annual energy savings. I enjoy applying engineering and data analysis to improve industrial processes.
